description: Reviewed fixes for packages and APIs that do not fit a target. Every entry links the source that supports it. See docs/contributing/suggestions.md.

chokidar.text: chokidar watches files, which Workers cannot do. Import it from development tooling only, and keep it out of what the Worker's entry imports.

cross-spawn.text: cross-spawn starts child processes, which Workers cannot do. Do that work outside the Worker, at build time or in a service the Worker calls with fetch.

node:child_process*.text: Workers cannot start processes. Do that work outside the Worker, at build time or in a service the Worker calls with fetch.

node:fs.watch*.text: Workers do not implement file watching. Run it in development tooling, not in code the Worker bundles.

node:fs.unwatchFile.text: Workers do not implement file watching. Run it in development tooling, not in code the Worker bundles.

node:fs.promises.watch.text: Workers do not implement file watching. Run it in development tooling, not in code the Worker bundles.

node:fs/promises.watch.text: Workers do not implement file watching. Run it in development tooling, not in code the Worker bundles.
